select-skin.name: Select skin
select-skin.desc: Open a dialog to select skins from the skeleton

select-animation.name: Select animation
select-animation.desc: Open a dialog to select an animation from the skeleton

spine-bounds-provider-group.name: Bounds provider
spine-bounds-provider-group.desc: Select the desired bound provider and fill the respective properties.

spine-bounds-provider-move.name: Position bounds
spine-bounds-provider-move.desc: Keep the skeleton in a fixed position while adjusting the size and position of the bounds.

spine-debug-skeleton.name: Debug skeleton
spine-debug-skeleton.desc: Draw debug visualization of the skeleton bones

spine-enable-collision.name: Enable collision
spine-enable-collision.desc: Enable collision detection by creating a Sprite collision body

set-bounds.name: Reset bounds
set-bounds.desc: Click to reset the bounds using the current configuration, but keeping the current scale.

on-skeleton-loaded.description: Do something when skeleton is loaded

on-animation-event.display-text: On {0} event triggered by animation {2} on track {1}
on-animation-event.description: Triggered when animation event occurs. Use empty string for event/animation or -1 for track to match any value.

event.name: Event name
event.desc: Event name (start, dispose, event, interrupt, end, complete). Empty string matches any event.

animation.name: Animation
animation.desc: Animation name. Empty string matches any animation.

track.name: Track number
track.desc: Track index. Use -1 to match any track.

is-mirrored.description: Check if the skeleton is mirrored horizontally

is-flipped.description: Check if the skeleton is flipped vertically

is-skeleton-loaded.description: Check if the skeleton has finished loading

is-playing.description: Check if the animation is currently playing

is-inside-slot.description: Check if a point in world coordinates is inside a slot's attachment polygon

slot-name.name: Slot name
slot-name.desc: Name of the slot to check

is-inside-bone-radius.display-text: Is point ({0}, {1}) within {3} pixels of bone {2}
is-inside-bone-radius.description: Check if a point in world coordinates is within a specified radius of a bone's position

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone to check

radius.name: Radius
radius.desc: Radius in pixels around the bone position

is-animation-playing.description: Check if animation is playing. Use empty string for animation or -1 for track to match any value.

animation-name.name: Animation name
animation-name.desc: Animation name. Empty string matches any animation.

track-index.name: Track index
track-index.desc: Track index. Use -1 to check all tracks.

skin-name.name: Skins list
skin-name.desc: A comma separated list of skins to set. Empty string to unset skins.

is-mirrored.name: Is mirrored
is-mirrored.desc: True to mirror the skeleton horizontally, false to show normally.

is-flipped.name: Is flipped
is-flipped.desc: True to flip the skeleton vertically, false to show normally.

set-animation.display-text: Set animation {1} on track {0} with loop {2}

add-animation.display-text: Add animation {1} on track {0} with loop {2} and delay {3}

set-empty-animation.display-text: Set empty animation on track {0} with mix duration {1}
set-empty-animation.description: Set an empty animation on a specific track

mix-duration.name: Mix duration
mix-duration.desc: Duration in seconds to mix from the current animation to empty

add-empty-animation.display-text: Add empty animation on track {0} with mix duration {1} and delay {2}
add-empty-animation.description: Add an empty animation to the animation queue on a specific track

mix-duration.name: Mix duration
mix-duration.desc: Duration in seconds to mix from the current animation to empty

delay.name: Delay
delay.desc: Delay in seconds before the animation starts

set-attachment.description: Change the attachment on a specific slot

attachment-name.name: Attachment name
attachment-name.desc: Name of the attachment to set

create-custom-skin.description: Create a new custom skin that can combine multiple skins

add-custom-skin.description: Add an existing skin to a custom skin

custom-skin-name.name: Custom skin name
custom-skin-name.desc: Name of the custom skin to add to

skin-to-add-name.name: Skin to add
skin-to-add-name.desc: Name of the existing skin to add

set-custom-skin.description: Apply a custom skin to the skeleton

skin-name.name: Skin name
skin-name.desc: Name of the custom skin to apply

set-time-scale.description: Set the time scale of animations (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double speed, 0.5 = half speed)

time-scale.name: Time scale
time-scale.desc: Time scale multiplier (1.0 is normal speed)

set-animation-time.description: Set the current time of an animation on a track

time.name: Time
time.desc: Time value (in seconds or as a ratio 0.0-1.0)

set-animation-mix.display-text: Set animation mix from {0} to {1} duration {2}
set-animation-mix.description: Set the blend/crossfade duration when transitioning from one animation to another

from-name.name: From animation
from-name.desc: Name of the animation to transition from

to-name.name: To animation
to-name.desc: Name of the animation to transition to

set-default-mix.description: Set the default crossfade duration used when transitioning between animations that don't have a specific mix defined

set-physics-mode.description: Set the physics mode to control how physics constraints are updated and applied

set-skeleton-color.description: Set the color of the entire skeleton. Accepts hex colors (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) or color names.

color.name: Color
color.desc: Color value (hex like #FF0000 or color name)

set-track-alpha.description: Set the alpha/opacity of an animation track. Used for blending animations on different tracks.

alpha.name: Alpha
alpha.desc: Alpha value (0.0 to 1.0, where 0 is transparent and 1 is opaque)

track-index.name: Track index
track-index.desc: Track index to set alpha for

set-track-mix-blend.description: Set the mix blend mode for an animation track. Controls how animations are layered and combined.

track-index.name: Track index
track-index.desc: Track index to set mix blend for

clear-track.description: Clear te given track, or all tracks if -1

track-index.name: Track index
track-index.desc: Track index to clear. -1 to clear all tracks.

set-slot-color.description: Set the color of a slot. Accepts hex colors (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) or color names.

slot-name.name: Slot name
slot-name.desc: Name of the slot to modify

color.name: Color
color.desc: Color value (hex like #FF0000 or color name)

reset-slot-colors.description: Reset slot colors to their setup pose values. Leave slot name empty to reset all slots.

slot-name.name: Slot name
slot-name.desc: Name of the slot to reset. Leave empty to reset all slots.

set-bone-pose.display-text: Set bone {0} position ({3}, {4}), rotation {5}, scale ({6}, {7}) in {1} mode, {2}
set-bone-pose.description: Set a bone's pose. Once: applied for the current frame only. Hold: re-applied every frame, merging with previously held values. Use Release bone hold to stop holding. Position and rotation use the selected coordinate space (game or local). Scale is always local.

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone to update

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Coordinate space for position and rotation. Local: values are applied directly as the bone's local pose. Game: values are converted from game space.

apply-mode.name: Apply
apply-mode.desc: Once: the pose is applied for the current frame only. Hold: the pose is re-applied every frame until released. In hold mode, values left as empty string preserve the previously held value on that axis.

x.name: X
x.desc: X position. Game space in game mode, bone-local in local mode. Leave as empty string to keep current value.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Y position. Game space in game mode, bone-local in local mode. Leave as empty string to keep current value.

rotation.name: Rotation
rotation.desc: Rotation in degrees. Game space in game mode, bone-local in local mode. Leave as empty string to keep current value.

scaleX.name: Scale X
scaleX.desc: Bone's local scale X. Always applied as local scale regardless of mode. Leave as empty string to keep current value.

scaleY.name: Scale Y
scaleY.desc: Bone's local scale Y. Always applied as local scale regardless of mode. Leave as empty string to keep current value.

release-bone-hold.display-text: Release hold on bone {0}, reset to setup pose: {1}
release-bone-hold.description: Release a held bone pose, allowing the animation to control the bone again. Optionally resets the bone to its setup pose.

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone to release

reset-to-setup.name: Reset to setup pose
reset-to-setup.desc: If checked, resets the bone to its setup pose after releasing the hold.

setup-pose.description: Reset bones and/or slots to their setup pose values.

target.name: Target
target.desc: What to reset to setup pose.

setup-bone-slot-pose.description: Reset a specific bone or slot to its setup pose values.

name.name: Name
name.desc: Name of the bone or slot to reset.

attach-instance-to-bone.display-text: Attach instance UID {0} to bone {1} with offset ({2}, {3}, {4}°)
attach-instance-to-bone.description: Make an object instance follow a skeleton bone's position and rotation. The instance will automatically update its position and angle to match the bone every frame. Offsets are applied in the bone's local space (rotated with the bone).

uid.name: UID
uid.desc: The UID of the object instance to attach (use expression like Sprite.UID)

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone to follow

offset-x.name: Offset X
offset-x.desc: X offset from bone position (in bone's local space)

offset-y.name: Offset Y
offset-y.desc: Y offset from bone position (in bone's local space)

offset-angle.name: Offset angle
offset-angle.desc: Angle offset in degrees from bone rotation

attach-object-to-bone.description: Make picked object instances follow a skeleton bone's position and rotation. The instances will automatically update their position and angle to match the bone every frame. Offsets are applied in the bone's local space (rotated with the bone).

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object type to attach (picked instances will be attached)

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone to follow

offset-x.name: Offset X
offset-x.desc: X offset from bone position (in bone's local space)

offset-y.name: Offset Y
offset-y.desc: Y offset from bone position (in bone's local space)

offset-angle.name: Offset angle
offset-angle.desc: Angle offset in degrees from bone rotation

detach-object-from-bone.description: Stop picked object instances from following a bone. The instances will remain at their current positions.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object type to detach (picked instances will be detached)

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone to detach from

detach-all-from-bone.description: Stop all object instances from following a bone. The instances will remain at their current positions.

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone to detach from

add-handle.display-text: Add interactive handle for {0} {1} with radius {2} (debug: {3})
add-handle.description: Add an interactive handle to a bone or slot that can be dragged with the mouse. The radius determines the clickable area.

name.name: Name
name.desc: Name of the bone or slot to add handle to

radius.name: Radius
radius.desc: Radius of the clickable area in pixels

debug.name: Debug
debug.desc: Whether to show debug visualization for the handle

remove-handle.description: Remove an interactive handle from a bone or slot.

name.name: Name
name.desc: Name of the bone or slot to remove handle from

set-bounds.description: Set the bounds of the game object in Spine world coordinates. The skeleton's visual size stays the same (only the bounding area changes). The skeleton remains rendered at the same position.

x.name: X
x.desc: X offset of the bounds in Spine world coordinates

y.name: Y
y.desc: Y offset of the bounds in Spine world coordinates

width.name: Width
width.desc: Width of the bounds in Spine world coordinates

height.name: Height
height.desc: Height of the bounds in Spine world coordinates

set-bounds-for-skin-animation.display-text: Set bounds for skins {0} and animation {1}
set-bounds-for-skin-animation.description: Calculate and set bounds based on the specified skins and animation. Uses a separate skeleton to compute the bounding box by stepping through the animation frames. The skeleton's visual size stays the same.

skins.name: Skins
skins.desc: Comma-separated list of skin names. Leave empty to use the default skin.

animation.name: Animation
animation.desc: Animation name to calculate bounds for. Leave empty to use setup pose.

set-bounds-for-setup-pose.description: Calculate and set bounds based on the skeleton's setup pose. The skeleton's visual size stays the same.

slot-attachment.description: Get the name of the attachment on a slot. Returns empty string if no attachment.

slot-attachment-placeholder.description: Get the skin placeholder name of the attachment on a slot, or the attachment name if using the default skin. Returns empty string if no attachment.

bone-x.description: Get the world X position of a bone.

bone-y.description: Get the world Y position of a bone.

bone-rotation.description: Get the world rotation of a bone.

bone-world-x.description: Get the C3 world X position of a bone.

bone-world-y.description: Get the C3 world Y position of a bone.

current-skin.description: Get the current skin name. Returns comma-separated names if multiple skins are active.

current-animation.description: Get the name of the currently playing animation on a specific track.

get-event-data.description: Get data from the last triggered animation event. Typically used within an 'On animation event' trigger. Valid fields: "float", "int", "string", "balance", "volume", "audiopath", "event", "track", "animation".

field.name: "float"|"int"|"string"|"balance"|"volume"|"audiopath"|"event"|"track"|"animation"
field.desc: The event data field to retrieve

time-scale.description: Get the current animation time scale (speed multiplier).

current-animation-start.description: Get the start time of the current animation on the specified track.

current-animation-end.description: Get the end time of the current animation on the specified track.

current-animation-last.description: Get the last applied time of the current animation on the specified track.

bounds-x.description: Get the X offset of the current bounds.

bounds-y.description: Get the Y offset of the current bounds.

bounds-width.description: Get the width of the current bounds.

bounds-height.description: Get the height of the current bounds.

spine-enable-collision.message: This is the last instance of {0}. You can delete the {0} or just disable the Sprite collision body. Deleting the Sprite collision body will remove all related ACEs in the event sheet, if there's any. How do you want to proceed?

skeleton-not-loaded.message: Skeleton not loaded. Please ensure atlas and skeleton files are set.

no-animations.title: No Animations
no-animations.message: No animations found in the skeleton.

no-skins.title: No Skins
no-skins.message: No skins found in the skeleton.

invalid-skins.message:

invalid-animation.message:
